item.title: Mark Walsh to partner well-fancied JP McManus runner in Grand National
item.description: Mark Walsh will aim to win the Grand National for JP McManus weeks before he is replaced as the owner's retained jockey

item.title: Paddy Donovan asks for prayers as his cousin fights for her life after assault
item.description: The boxer has asked for people to keep his cousin in their thoughts as she fights for her life

item.title: Supercomputer World Cup play-off prediction is good news for Ireland
item.description: The stats suggest it's all leading up to an Ireland v Denmark play-off finale at the Aviva next week.

item.title: Kerry native in Prague coach urges others to follow in Robbie Keane footsteps
item.description: Father-of-two O’Carroll has fully embraced life in Prague, but is also working with the Northern Ireland team for their World Cup play-off

item.title: 'Masterpiece' Saoirse Ronan film called 'best movie ever made' now on Netflix
item.description: Greta Gerwig's critically acclaimed 2017 coming-of-age drama starring Saoirse Ronan and Timothée Chalamet is now streaming on Netflix

item.title: Young dad killed in Cork attack remembered as family's 'whole world' at funeral
item.description: A young father killed in a random attack in Cork was remembered at his funeral as a devoted husband and loving dad whose family was his 'whole world'.

item.title: Sir Gino dead: Nicky Henderson-trained star dies from infection
item.description: Nicky Henderson has announced the death of his top-class performer Sir Gino after the six-year-old lost his battle with a severe infection

item.title: Two students and adult injured in school stabbing as suspect arrested
item.description: A suspect has been detained after a stabbing at Walton Middle School in DeFuniak Springs, Florida left two students and an adult injured and rushed to hospital

item.title: Tributes to man feared perished in blaze at home with previous tragedy
item.description: Christopher ‘Crunchie’ Holt, who was in his 60s, is believed to have died in a tragic incident when a fire broke out at the home

item.title: Met Éireann Status Yellow Wind warning for five counties active till midnight
item.description: Potential impacts include some fallen trees and branches, difficult travel, large coastal waves and potentially damaging gusts
